_about: The transition registry, shared by both studios. Generated fields (pre, post, fn, engines, used_in, verdicts per edit, status) are rebuilt by `python3 tools/preflight.py registry` from the engines and the EDLs; curated fields (verdict, tags, evidence, fix, family, studio) are the owner's verdicts, kept across rebuilds. plan_check reads both. verdict: liked / ok / rejected / banned. tags: generic, black_occluder, face_gimmick, signature, physical, lands_on_face, leaks, caution. family: one hero asset (more than 4 transitions warns, more than 8 fails). Add a verdict in the same turn the owner gives it.

families.note: A family is one hero asset. plan_check counts each family's transitions: more than 4 warns (v13 rule: the hero asset is a motif, 2-4 appearances), more than 8 fails (v13 rev 1 had 11 singularity transitions: 'I really don't like this edit').
